verdict.rationale: The docs say scheduled tasks can start when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs. Examples include triaging new email, summarizing channel activity, and acting on PR feedback without polling, alongside recurring background tasks you can review in Scheduled. That covers the core of event-triggered automation. Missing for 10: event sources beyond Gmail/Slack/GitHub, documented rule conditions/filters for when a trigger fires, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
